skills.description: Mandatory quality-assurance workflow for ALL coding tasks that produce code, web pages, command-line tools, scripts, or applications. Enforces a 4-phase lifecycle: (0) 讨论阶段 — clarify requirements from product-manager AND senior-finance-manager perspectives, proactively surface unclear points / missed aspects / risks, give optimization suggestions, and get explicit "执行" sign-off before coding; (1) 计划阶段 — produce a versioned requirement document (HTML or Word preferred) that any developer can pick up and understand the whole requirement quickly; (2) 开发过程 — design for speed and compatibility (works on machines without extra environments installed), self-test from the smallest sample up to 3+ loops while monitoring runtime, then open the tool UI for the user to test; (3) 总结阶段 — generate ONE comprehensive document (cover page + clickable table of contents with jump-and-return navigation) that merges user quick-start, business-logic explanation, and development key points, plus a web-format retrospective file capturing the big problems encountered (especially gaps in the discussion/planning phases), and ASK the user item-by-item whether to add learnings to the knowledge base. For small-tool coding requests (VBA or Python), a strict confirmation gate applies: discuss thoroughly from product-manager and senior-finance-manager perspectives, provide recommendations, and only start coding after the user explicitly says "执行".
